governing_question: Can this signal earn and keep the right to influence capital allocation?
objective: Test whether the system can understand enacted U.S. federal legislation from point-in-time information, map economically material beneficiaries and losers before observing outcomes, and distinguish legal interpretation accuracy from investment usefulness.

required_case_types: second-order supplier, customer or competitor effect
case_selection.anti_cherry_pick_rule: The case list and category labels must be locked before reading post-event price performance or retrospective explanatory reporting.
case_selection.no_fame_requirement: Cases may be nationally prominent or niche, but selection cannot depend on knowing that a famous trade worked.

temporal_firewall.retrospective_reporting_role: Post-outcome mainstream, trade-publication and niche reporting may explain realized transmission only after the memo is sealed.

evidence_record_schema.affected_claims_rule: Supporting, contradicting and mixed evidence must identify at least one affected claim. Neutral context may use an empty list.
evidence_record_schema.late_discovery_rule: Any post-outcome source that was already available before the memo seal must be listed as late-discovered pre-cutoff evidence so the omission is visible and auditable.
evidence_record_schema.immutability_rule: Evidence records are append-only. A correction creates a superseding record and preserves the original evidence_id.

interpretation_accuracy.purpose: Measure whether the system correctly understood what the law changed, independent of whether the security made money.

investment_usefulness.purpose: Measure whether the sealed interpretation identified an executable exposure with abnormal after-cost value.

case_stage_rules.selected: Case selection is locked, but the point-in-time packet is incomplete.
case_stage_rules.packet_locked: The point-in-time input packet and its hash are complete; no outcome information may be present.
case_stage_rules.memo_sealed: The policy-impact memo is complete and hashed; no outcome information may be present.
case_stage_rules.outcome_revealed: The sealed memo exists and the post-event outcome packet has been opened.
case_stage_rules.scored: Both score families and written attribution review are complete.
case_stage_rules.retired: The case remains in the audit trail but is excluded for a documented data or design defect.

prohibited_practices: Do not select cases because the subsequent winner is already known.
Do not use post-event prices, earnings, company commentary or retrospective articles before the memo is sealed.
Do not rewrite the memo after outcome reveal; corrections require a new version and preserve the original.
Do not treat correct legal interpretation as proof of trading alpha.
Do not treat a profitable stock move as proof that the legal interpretation caused it.
Do not exclude failed intuitive trades, no-trade conclusions or ambiguous cases from the benchmark.
Do not omit, downgrade or bury contradictory evidence without an explicit source-level record and review note.
Do not authorize real-money trading from this benchmark.
